summary: Per minute on the shape you reserve, with disk billed every hour until you delete the instance.

egress.note: Not published: the billing docs meter only compute and disk.

notes: Creating an instance needs one day of its running cost in the wallet.
Stopping loses memory; a sleep checkpoint keeps it at no extra charge.
The managed personal-agent plans ($3.99 to $99.99 a month) are a separate product and are not priced here.
The wallet is metered per minute. How a final partial minute is charged is not published, so runs are priced at their exact length; with whole-minute runs the two agree.

upkeep.label: What you keep up
upkeep.detail: Its hosting plans promise automatic updates and security patches, but its API docs say an instance keeps the image it was created from until you run an update, and an update resets anything installed outside your files.

source.quote: Existing instances are unaffected: an instance keeps the image it was created from until you update it.
